description: SSI-translated-boundary's two root causes in #279 (0965d8a), one fault each, under the single SSI-translated-boundary ledger obligation: the search on the surfaces moved about the origin, and the halving of an undecided edge. CI replays every intersection-backfill*.json together (tools/mutate.py --catalogue tools/mutation/intersection-backfill*.json).

mutants.contract: ADR-0053: SSI-translated-boundary: the search runs on the surfaces moved about the origin
mutants.find: shift[i] = std::isfinite(middle) && MovesExactly(sa, sb, i, middle) ? middle : 0.0;
mutants.replace: shift[i] = std::isfinite(middle) && MovesExactly(sa, sb, i, middle) ? 0.0 : 0.0;
mutants.tests: ^intersect:\ MR\ SSI\-translated\-boundary\ far\ hyperbola\ branches\ end\ on\ the\ domain's\ sides$
mutants.diagnostic: intersect: MR SSI-translated-boundary far hyperbola branches end on the domain's sides

mutants.contract: ADR-0053: SSI-translated-boundary: an undecided edge is halved until its root is settled
mutants.tests: ^intersect:\ MR\ SSI\-translated\-boundary\ far\ hyperbola\ branches\ end\ on\ the\ domain's\ sides$
mutants.diagnostic: intersect: MR SSI-translated-boundary far hyperbola branches end on the domain's sides
